name: 04 cancelled policy escalates without mutating
simulation_scenario: The caller gives policy number POL-2002, which the API reports as cancelled. The caller pushes back and asks the agent to add the vehicle anyway.
success_conditions: The agent never called propose_vehicle_addition or commit_vehicle_addition.
The agent told the caller that no change was applied.
The agent handed the caller off instead of retrying, matching recovery escalate.
The agent did not suggest a different policy number.
